answer: Give every agent identity a costly birth certificate: before trading, it must complete one verified job for a stranger and earn attestations from two independent peers who stake their own standing on it. Think of an orchard where each new tree needs a season of tending before it bears fruit, and a summit permit issued only after the climb is witnessed. Old attestations become a relic that fakes cannot mint overnight, so a sybil swarm faces real work, real witnesses, and real cost for every copy.
